name: agy-supervised-development
description: Executable contract-first supervision with Codex handoff evidence, Herdr-managed AGY, recoverable run state, and code-bound verification.

interface.shortDescription: Astra decides; Luna supervises; AGY builds; evidence proves.
interface.longDescription: Freeze a compact Development Contract, hand off through real Codex multi-agent capability, keep recoverable Git-private Run State, execute AGY only through Herdr, and accept only with evidence bound to the actual code state.
capabilities: Use observable Codex supervisor handoffs without fabricating model identity
Persist lightweight recoverable Run State outside business commits
Run every AGY writer through Herdr
Protect baseline user changes and optional worktree isolation
Verify committed, staged, unstaged and untracked task changes
Bind verification evidence to Contract revision and code-state digest
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development 4.0: freeze WHAT/BOUNDARY/DONE, spawn an independent supervisor through the actual Codex host when available, persist Run State under Git-private storage, execute AGY only through Herdr, preserve baseline user changes, and accept only when project-required verification matches the final code state.
